                    ### Question
                    Which of the following cell types produces testosterone?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Sertoli cells.
opb. Leydig cells.
opc. Myoid cells
opd. Spermatogonias

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Leydig cells are the primary cell type that produces testosterone in the testes. Sertoli cells support sperm development but do not produce testosterone. Myoid cells provide structural support in the seminiferous tubules and do not produce testosterone. Spermatogonias are germ cells that give rise to sperm and also do not produce testosterone. Evidence paths confirm the role of Leydig cells in testosterone production.
